manufacturer_evidence.interpretation: Each manufacturer-supported pair is bound to an exact canonical part/tool SKU edge, a credential-free HTTPS source, a locator, and a note. This is edge-level source support; it does not establish that every other part/tool edge has manufacturer evidence.

same_product_family.interpretation: Exact brand, product-kind, and product-family matches for tools and toolsets. Series and category may differ. This is broad family discovery, not fitment, equivalence, replacement, upgrade, bundle contents, or commercial suitability.

same_catalog_category.interpretation: Exact brand, product-kind, and display-category peers for published visible non-part products. Discovery-only; it does not establish fitment, equivalence, substitution, or a curated commercial recommendation.

variation_hierarchy.interpretation: Exact SKU-to-parent-SKU structure from the canonical WooCommerce Parent field; it is not a fitment or merchandising relationship.

part_family_affiliations.interpretation: Derived family/subfamily affiliations inherit the evidence status of exact recorded fitment edges and are not written back as canonical part metadata.

family_metadata.interpretation: Membership is copied from exact canonical product_family and series fields. It does not prove substitution, compatibility, or independent source verification. The separate same_product_family edge uses exact brand, kind, and product_family while allowing category and series differences; same_catalog_category separately uses exact brand, kind, and display-category fields. Both are discovery-only.

interpretation: No recorded relationship is not evidence of incompatibility or a recommendation. Family discovery uses exact canonical brand, product kind, and product family, while remaining separate from fitment and merchandising.
